name_zh: 俾斯麦/德国/铁血宰相/统一/保险/同盟
description_zh: 奥托·冯·俾斯麦 (1815-1898) 普鲁士首相、德意志帝国首任铁血宰相，通过三次战争完成德意志统一，建立三帝同盟体系，创立世界首个社会保险体系（医疗/工伤/养老），实行铁血现实politik平衡欧洲大陆势力。
description_en: Otto von Bismarck (1815-1898) Prussian Minister President, first Iron Chancellor of German Empire, achieved German unification through three wars, established Three Emperors League system, created world's first social insurance system (health/workers' comp/pension), practiced Realpolitik balancing European continental powers.
reason_zh: 俾斯麦代表现实主义外交如何通过战争与外交双重手段完成民族统一，展示了社会保险如何作为国家整合工具安抚工人阶级，其均势外交体系维持欧洲和平四十年，铁血宰相模式影响现代地缘政治。
reason_en: Bismarck represents how realist diplomacy achieves national unification through war and diplomacy dual approach, demonstrating how social insurance serves as state integration tool appeasing working class, his balance-of-power system maintained European peace for forty years, Iron Chancellor model influencing modern geopolitics.
steps_zh: 研究俾斯麦早年容克地主与普鲁士议会冲突
分析1864/1866/1870三次战争统一德意志进程
探讨1880s社会保险立法与镇压社会党法并行
评估三帝同盟/再保险条约均势外交体系构建
总结铁血现实politik/社会保险/均势外交三重遗产
steps_en: Study Bismarck early Junker landowner vs Prussian Parliament conflict
Analyze 1864/1866/1870 three wars unifying Germany process
Explore 1880s social insurance legislation and Anti-Socialist Laws parallel
Evaluate Three Emperors League/Reinsurance Treaty balance-of-power system construction
expected_zh: 掌握战争外交双轮驱动民族统一逻辑，理解社会保险作为国家整合工具的运作机制，评估俾斯麦均势外交对现代地缘政治的深远影响。
expected_en: Master war-diplomacy dual-wheel driving national unification logic, understand social insurance as state integration tool operating mechanism, evaluate Bismarck balance-of-power diplomacy profound impact on modern geopolitics.
case_zh: 1862 铁血演说；1871 殿堂加冕；1883/1884/1889 社会保险三部曲；1890 解职。铁血宰相/社会保险/均势外交范式永存。
case_en: 1862 Blood and Iron speech; 1871 Hall of Mirrors coronation; 1883/1884/1889 social insurance trilogy; 1890 dismissal. Iron Chancellor/social insurance/balance-of-power paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: German unification; social insurance; Realpolitik; balance of power
